names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 28 aprilie, «Sfinții Mucenici Maxim, Cvintilian și Dadas din Ozovia».

Read out of saint.gr's page for 13 Απριλίου, which heads him «Αγιος Κυντιλιανος» and lists him in the day's line «Άγιοι Κυντιλλιανός, Μάξιμος και Δάδας», with the rank word left off. The two spellings, Κυντιλιανος in the heading and Κυντιλλιανός in the line and the couplet, are both the page's; the heading's is stored here.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's heading for 28. април ст. ст., „Св. муч. Максим, Дада и Квинтилијан.“ Св. муч. stands over all three names and муч. is the `martyr` this folder already carries; the heading gives no epithet and no village. The form drops the Latin -us of Quintilianus, which is this page's habit with Latin names.

The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 1191, «Квинтилиан (Кинтилиан) Доростольский, Озовийский, мч.», with the rank word left off and the parenthesis left out of the form. THE PARENTHESIS HERE IS NOT A SURNAME: unlike «Мария (Носова)», where it holds the family name, it holds a second reading of the forename, «Кинтилиан», which the calendar prints as an alternative and which is recorded here rather than stored as part of the name. The comma inside the form is the calendar's own and separates two toponymics, Durostorum and the village of Ozovia. Measured against the gate's own key function: 'доростольскии квинтилиан озовиискии' has no other holder in the corpus.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 апреля ст. ст. — «Мчч. Дады , Максима и Квинтилиана (286).»

attestations.note: The day's second entry of five, one line naming three brothers. His name page heads him «Квинтилиан (Кинтилиан) Доростольский, Озовийский, мч.», and the parenthesis is a second reading of the forename rather than a surname, so the stored form carries «Квинтилиан» and the note records «Кинтилиан» as the variant the page also prints. The life page spells him «Квинтиллиан» with a double L in one place and «Квинтилиан» in the others, which is the page's own inconsistency and not a reading of mine. The day page prints no hymn under their names.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 28 aprilie — «Sfinții Mucenici Maxim, Cvintilian și Dadas din Ozovia»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Απριλίου — «Άγιοι Κυντιλλιανός, Μάξιμος και Δάδας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 13 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives the three no years: it sets them only in the reigns of «Μαξιμιανού (285 - 305 μ.Χ.) και Διοκλητιανού (284 - 305 μ.Χ.)» and under «τῶν ὑπάτων Γαβιβίου και Ταρκυΐνου», so no `dates` were taken. **The Greek keeps the three a fortnight before the Romanian**, which prints them on 28 aprilie; both pages are the same company — the three readers of the Church from Ozovia, beheaded together — and the Greek adds their office, the consuls' names, and the resting place of the relics at Constantinople, in the church of the Most Holy Mother of God «ἐν τοὶς Βιγλεντίου», where their synaxis was kept. The page prints no hymn.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 11.05.2026 (28. април ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Максим, Дада и Квинтилијан.“

attestations.note: The third name of an enumerated heading of three. Three short sentences: Diocletian's time, the voivode Tarquinius as judge, prison and torments, and beheading with the sword. **This book keeps the three on 28 April with the Romanian calendar and against the Greek 13 April**, and **„у време Диоклецијана“ is a reign with no printed bounds** and was not turned into a date, so this folder stays undated. The Prologue prints no hymn.

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfinților Mucenici Maxim, Cvintilian și Dadas din Ozovia», Glasul 4

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their striving won from Thee, our God, the crowns of incorruption; for having Thy strength, they overthrew their tormentors and shattered the feeble daring of the demons. By their prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 28 апреля ст. ст. closes «(286)» for the three brothers, and its life page life947 ends «отвели под стражей в их деревню и там усекли мечом (+ 286)». The two agree, and the folder had no year of any kind before.
